verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official CLI. It is documented in a CLI reference, can be installed as a standalone tool via uvx, and the environment docs show CLI commands with an `--env` flag. Its official coding-agent skill adds to the AI-native fit. Missing for 10: detail on the breadth of CLI commands, and evidence of agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
